title: File:Blue Origin New Glenn Rocket Successful Launch (9387524).jpg
art: U.S. Space Force photo by Senior Airman Samuel Becker
desc: A New Glenn rocket launches from Space Launch Complex 36 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Florida, Nov. 13, 2025. New Glenn can carry more than 13 metric tons to geostationary transfer orbit (GTO) and 45 metric tons to low Earth orbit (LEO). (U.S. Space Force photo by Staff Sergeant Samuel Bec
